structures.name: Corpus Callosum
structures.about: The great commissure joining the two cerebral hemispheres, seen in section as a broad white band above the ventricles.

structures.name: Septum Pellucidum
structures.about: The thin midline membrane separating the two lateral ventricles, stretched between the corpus callosum and the fornix.

structures.name: Lateral Ventricle
structures.about: The paired cerebrospinal fluid cavities within each cerebral hemisphere, curving beneath the corpus callosum.

structures.name: Caudate
structures.about: One of the basal ganglia, bulging into the lateral ventricle. It contributes to the control of voluntary movement.

structures.name: Septal Nucleus
structures.about: Gray matter at the base of the septum, a limbic center connected to the hippocampus through the fornix.

structures.name: Internal Capsule
structures.about: The compact sheet of projection fibers between the caudate and thalamus medially and the lentiform nucleus laterally.

structures.name: Extreme Capsule
structures.about: The outermost thin white lamina, between the claustrum and the insular cortex.

structures.name: External Capsule
structures.about: The thin white lamina between the putamen and the claustrum.

structures.name: Claustrum
structures.about: The thin sheet of gray matter between the external and extreme capsules.

structures.name: Putamen
structures.about: The lateral part of the lentiform nucleus, one of the basal ganglia involved in motor control.
